findings.finding: [native] In the hovered row (and in the Serilog.Sinks.Console row), the 20 px 'Installed' label badge is not centred vertically in the 22 px compact row band. It starts 2 px below the band top (y 56) and runs down to the band's bottom edge (y 75 in a band of 54–75), so it looks like it rests on the band's bottom edge. Native tree-row badges sit centred in their band. | [geometry] In the hovered Serilog row, the Installed label badge sits off-centre in the 22 px band: it spans y 56–75 inside the band at y 54–75, so it has 2 px above and 0 px below and its bottom edge lies on the band's bottom edge. Its text reads about 2 px lower than the name beside it. The non-hovered Serilog.Sinks.Console row shows the same 2/0 offset, with the badge at y 100–119 in a row at y 98–119.
findings.owner: UX-P3.fix-5, eb70248 (align-self: center on the compact row's badge slot; DS-ROW-7)
findings.evidence: design-advisor follow-up 4 of 2026-11-13 (UX-P3.8, in src/webview/sidebar/STATUS.md): the shared compact row places the badge by its text baseline (primitives.css:490-494, 511-514, 623-649: `.nuiget-row--compact .nuiget-row-body` is `align-items: baseline`), so a 20 px label badge sits 2/0 in the 22 px band; the same offset is in the sidebar-all-projects golden since UX-P3.7c. Not this item's file (plan §2.1); the fix is the badge slot centred in the existing `.nuiget-row--compact .nuiget-row-badges` rule, with a new rule (badge centred within 1 px, never touching the band) landing pending on the owner row first.
